# Select
A form control for choosing one option from a predefined list. Visually matches Input but semantically a combobox — not an action menu (use Dropdown Menu for actions).

USE WHEN
• Choosing one option from a predefined list (country, currency, frequency)
• Form fields where the options are too many for radio buttons (>5)
• Dashboard filters and settings dropdowns

DON'T USE WHEN
• Triggering an action — use Dropdown Menu instead
• Fewer than 3 options — use Radio Group instead
• Multi-select is needed (v1 is single-choice only)

DO
• Always provide a placeholder that describes the expected selection
• Keep option labels short and scannable
• Group related options with labels and separators when the list is long

DON'T
• Mix Select with Dropdown Menu — they are semantically different (combobox vs menu)
• Use Select for navigation — it is a form control, not a menu

PROPERTIES
• Size: sm (32px) | md (40px) — matches Input heights
• State: default | hover | focus | open | disabled | invalid
• Placeholder: boolean — true shows placeholder text, false shows selected value

TOKENS
• Trigger: background, border / border-strong / primary / danger, radius/md, spacing/3 padding
• Popover: surface-overlay, border, shadow/md, radius/md
• Items: background-accent (focus), foreground, primary (checkmark), radius/sm

CODE
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue } from '@atlas/ui-web';

<Select value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
  <SelectTrigger size="md">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select option" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="daily">Daily</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="weekly">Weekly</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="monthly">Monthly</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
